Child of Issue https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/317#issuecomment-829077114 specific to [PCI-DSS v3.2.1 Requirement 6.5](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/136826/116528539-4b757000-a91f-11eb-8be3-189a1f01fe16.png)

The process will be to extract the CWE of ASVS 4.0.2 and the following to be forked into ASVS PCI-DSS:

The following "CERT Secure Coding Standard" cited by [MITRE](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/index.html) are:
- [Perl](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1178.html) 
- [C](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1154.html) 

The [OWASP Top Ten 2017](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1026.html) cited by [MITRE](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/index.html).

Finally, the [MITIRE Top 25 (2020)](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1350.html).

This recommendation is from issue to issue, please:
* point/describe, with what ASVS requirement it's related
* define what is exactly the problem you want to point out or solve
* what is your proposal

Without those simple and clear elements in issue, all those links to n different sources are just noise. Or I just failing to understand those posts and comments...
Any clear proposal or it makes sense to close this issue?
